title: Evidence detail answers one item and deep pages and failed reads are told apart from empty
hosted_verification_note: No VM or SSH access performed; functional evidence only (local Postgres 43000-row table with the hosted by_source_type mix, recorded row shapes). Hosted verification belongs to the operator acceptance task.

Tests: test_detail_is_unavailable_not_404_unless_the_owner_answered_404[500,502,503,401,403,timeout,None], test_detail_is_404_when_the_owner_answered_404, test_real_pg_tenant_item_under_bare_record_id_is_readable_by_detail_as_the_list_shows_it (evi-607b5b55229e8f72 shape).
